title: Tableau Data Source Connection Errors
dataSources: Tableau Server logs (`tableau:backgrounder`, `tableau:vizqlserver`, `tableau:httpd`), `workgroup` repository tables (`background_jobs`, `http_requests`, `_views_stats`, `licensing`) via DB Connect, Tableau Cloud Admin Insights / Activity Log exports.
app: Splunk DB Connect (Splunkbase 2686) against the Tableau Server `workgroup` PostgreSQL repository; Tableau Server logs via Universal Forwarder; Tableau Server REST API and TSM metrics via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:dataserver ("connection failed" OR "unable to connect" OR error_code=*)
| stats count as errors by datasource_name, error_code
| where errors>0
| sort - errors
description: Surfaces connection failures between Tableau and the databases behind published data sources so broken credentials or unreachable databases are fixed quickly.
value: When Tableau cannot reach a source database, every workbook on that source breaks at once; catching connection errors early limits the blast radius.
implementation: Ingest `tableau:dataserver`; schedule every 15 minutes; alert on new error codes. Correlate with the database category (cat-07) for root cause.
visualization: Table of datasource/error_code, timechart of connection errors.
grandmaExplanation: We notice when Tableau cannot reach the databases behind your reports, so a broken connection gets fixed before all those reports go blank.
